description: TfL aggregates its 2023 public transport accessibility grid to ward areas. The description identifies minimum, maximum and mean access-index statistics and PTAL classification. The feature-service schema uses 2024 ward codes and names; that boundary vintage is distinct from the 2023 accessibility reference year. CSV and feature-service listings describe the same ward resource. The item snippet contains an MSOA wording inconsistency, while its detailed description and fields specify wards. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
